MnCaCs biominerals are a versatile and promising platform to construct multifunctional theranostic nanoplatform for cancer treatment.

the biomineralization of MnCaCs on the surface of oncolytic adenovirus can not only protect the virus from the immune system and prolong the in vivo circulation time, but also enhance its antitumor efficacy by releasing the Mn2+, which can convert endogenous H 2O 2 to O 2 and then enhance the replication of adenovirus in the tumor cells, thus significantly improving the antitumor efficiency.
